excerpt_kr: KPIPA(한국출판문화산업진흥원)​는 한국 출판 콘텐츠의 해외 진출을 지원하는 정부 산하 기관입니다. 스튜디오 하누리는 KPIPA의 번역 지원을 받아 현재 한국 그림책 3권을 네덜란드어로 번역하고 있습니다.
title_nl: Dankzij subsidies van KPIPA werkt Studio Hanuri aan de Nederlandse vertaling van drie Koreaanse prentenboeken.
excerpt_en: KPIPA (the Publication Industry Promotion Agency of Korea) is a government organization that promotes Korean publishing content abroad. With support from a KPIPA translation grant, Studio Hanuri is currently translating three Korean picture books into Dutch.
title_kr: 스튜디오 하누리,  KPIPA의 번역 지원금을 받아 한국 그림책 3권의 네덜란드어 번역을 진행
title_en: Studio Hanuri works on Dutch translation of 3 Korean picture books thanks to the grants of Kpipa
excerpt_nl: KPIPA (de Publication Industry Promotion Agency of Korea) is een overheidsorganisatie die Koreaanse publicaties internationaal promoot. Met steun van een vertaalsubsidie van KPIPA werkt Studio Hanuri momenteel aan de Nederlandse vertaling van drie Koreaanse prentenboeken.
